definitions: An indicator light on an electronic device that illuminates when the device is connected to a power source and its battery is being charged.
A light, often on a vehicle's dashboard, that indicates the alternator or charging system is functioning or has a fault.
examples: The charging light on my phone turned green, indicating it was fully charged.
The mechanic said the charging light on the car was on because of a faulty alternator.
I plugged in the laptop, and the charging light immediately came on.
